content:
anya: Quick heads-up — PTQ vs FP16 bring-up for reranker-rk-lite. Ran evaluation on full dev + a long-doc slice, and I'm seeing a surprising +3% MRR for PTQ on docs >1024 tokens. Anyone seen this before?
max: Whoa, +3%? Is that full dev or just the tail slice?
anya: Tail slice only (qlen>20 && doc_tokens>1024). Commands used: `eval_rerank --model=rk-lite:fp16 --split=dev_tail` and `eval_rerank --model=rk-lite:ptq8 --split=dev_tail`
raj: Can you paste the minimal command + the raw metrics you saw?
anya: Sure — pasted outputs below:
```
# command
eval_rerank --model rk-lite:fp16 --queries tail_2k --out fp16.csv
eval_rerank --model rk-lite:ptq8 --queries tail_2k --out ptq.csv

# summary (slice=tail_2k)
# metric,fp16,ptq8
ndcg@10,0.412,0.438
mrr@10,0.321,0.331
p@1,0.227,0.235
```
ciara: Did you use the same doc prep? We saw a truncation/sep token issue in the new prep that can change ranking for long docs — PTQ might be more robust to that artifact.
anya: Good call — I used doc-prep v2 which keeps full docs and inserts <DOC_SEP>. Old prep truncated to 1024 tokens with different padding. I'll rerun with v1 to compare.
perf-bot: Note: the PTQ runs had CPU-side scoring batch=16; FP16 used batch=8 due to memory settings — could affect internal scoring ordering and nondet tie-breaks.
max: If batching/threading differ, throughput/ordering might change top-k ties. Also check deterministic flags.
raj: And tokenization parity — are both runs using the same tokenizer binary and vocab? Small tokenization diffs can flip ranking on long documents.
anya: Plan: 1) rerun both models with identical batch/threading and same tokenizer binary, 2) run both with doc-prep v1 and v2, 3) fix random seed / deterministic flags. Will run a 2k-query A/B so we can bootstrap CI. Tagging @ciara for prep parity.
ciara: :thumbsup: I'll dump the exact prep config and diff the outputs. Also will check if v2 introduced extra whitespace that changes token counts.
anya: If effect persists after parity checks, we should run a tiny A/B in staging and consider adding a routing rule to prefer PTQ for long-doc-heavy traffic (but only after latency + tail-regret checks).
max: Agreed. If stable, add a canary rule + guardrail. Also run cost delta and SLO check.
perf-bot: GPU bench queue ETA ~2h. Ping here when you need infra.
anya: Will do. I'll post the parity runs and a short artifacts link when they're done — aiming by EOD.
